Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly identified the film as "Happy Death Day 2U (2017)" in its first response. The error stems from a failure to accurately parse the search results, specifically misreading the sequel title (Happy Death Day 2U, released in 2019) as the primary 2017 film. This initial hallucination of the title and release year caused a cascade of confusion, leading the Planner to repeatedly issue correction instructions and the WebSurfer to continue retrieving the same noisy search results without successfully isolating the correct 2017 film details in a clear, verified manner.
